user.title: InkView setup
user.description: Connect this Home Assistant instance to InkView. InkView reads sensor data directly from Home Assistant using a read-only token (valid for 1 year — it can never control or write to Home Assistant). Until the cloud pairing flow is available, paste a shared secret generated by your InkView server (or accept the pre-filled one and copy it back to InkView's side).

data_description.secret: Generate one with `openssl rand -hex 32`. Both ends need the same value.
data_description.all_sensors: On = InkView can read every numeric sensor (the 'all' option). Turn off to restrict it to a hand-picked list below.
data_description.allowed_entities: Only used when 'Expose all sensors' is off. These are the only sensors InkView can read, and the energy ones among them feed the total-energy figure.
data_description.show_sidebar_panel: Adds an InkView entry to Home Assistant's left sidebar with the total-energy view.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate InkView
reauth_confirm.description: The stored shared secret is no longer accepted. Paste a fresh 64-char hex secret — it will replace the old one and outstanding tokens stop working.

error.bad_secret: Secret must be 64 hex characters (32 bytes).

abort.already_configured: This InkView connection is already set up.

init.title: InkView options
init.description: Choose which sensors InkView may read via /api/inkview/v1/states/*. Tokens issued to InkView are read-only and valid for 1 year. The energy sensors in scope (Wh/kWh/MWh) are summed into sensor.inkview_total_energy.

data_description.all_sensors: On = every numeric sensor is readable (the 'all' option). Turn off to restrict to the list below.
data_description.allowed_entities: Only used when 'Expose all sensors' is off.

rotate_secret.name: Rotate shared secret
rotate_secret.description: Generate a new shared secret. The new value is shown once in a persistent notification.

revoke_all_tokens.name: Revoke all bearer tokens
revoke_all_tokens.description: Invalidate every outstanding read-only bearer without changing the shared secret.

no_energy_sensors.title: InkView — No energy sensors selected
no_energy_sensors.description: InkView's total energy reads 0 because none of the selected sensors report energy (Wh/kWh/MWh). Open the InkView integration options and pick at least one energy sensor.
